card.name: Spot right before the word in
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase (a condition, risk, drug name or finding) just before the word "in" introduces a population, such as "in patients" or "in humans".

modes.label: Condition or finding before in
modes.description: A medical term such as cancer, tumors, reactions or disorder that is followed by in plus a patient group.
modes.example: which means it can cause<< cancer>> in humans.

modes.label: Brand name before in patients
modes.description: The end of a brand drug name in a caution or avoid-use statement, followed by in patients with a condition.
modes.example: Avoid use of TAVNE<<OS>> in patients with active, serious infection,

modes.label: Closing bracket or verb before in
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or a verb like occurred, right before in and a group or percentage.
modes.example: Grade 3 or higher liver test abnormalities<< occurred>> in 5.1% (ALT

card.writes: It raises the word "in" (and its equivalents in other languages) as the next word, and lowers "among".
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say "in" followed by a patient group.
